ui.prep.bench: STOCK — meat on coals • vinaigrette at prep
ui.prep.hint: Tap vinaigrette → wait → drag to order
ui.result.title: TURN COMPLETE
ui.school.brasa.body: Drag a cut from the bench onto the coals. Each row is a different heat: low at the top, high at the bottom — hotter cooks faster and burns sooner.
ui.school.brasa.short: Drag from the bench onto a heat row.
ui.school.brasa.title: The bench is your stock
ui.school.combo.body: Serving in the perfect window pays more coins and more XP. Back-to-back serves light the COMBO and multiply the whole turn.
ui.school.combo.short: Perfect timing: more coins, more XP, combo.
ui.school.combo.title: PERFECT pays more
ui.school.entrySub: {count} quick lessons · what every action does
ui.school.noUnlock: Keep cooking to unlock the next cut
ui.school.ponto.body: When the face-down side browns, tap the cut to flip it. Flipping on time evens both sides out — that is how you score PERFECT.
ui.school.ponto.short: Flip when the face-down side is browned.
ui.school.ponto.title: Wait for the browning, then flip
ui.school.progresso.body: Every turn pays XP. Leveling up unlocks new cuts on the bench and bigger grills with more rows to cook at once.
ui.school.progresso.title: XP unlocks new things
ui.school.reposicao.body: No coals, no cooking; no meat, nothing to serve. The two buttons at the bottom refill both for free: charcoal in 2.2 s, stock in 3 s.
ui.school.reposicao.title: Charcoal and stock run out
ui.school.servir.body: Drag the cooked plate onto the customer card. The bar on the card is their patience: when it empties they leave and your combo goes with them.
ui.school.servir.short: The bar on the card is the customer's patience.
ui.school.servir.title: Serve before patience runs out
ui.school.title: GRILL SCHOOL
